mapper.sql: c.*, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m_unread WHERE m_unread.conversation_id = c.id AND m_unread.read_at IS NULL ), 0) AS unread_count, ( SELECT m_preview.content FROM messages m_preview WHERE m_preview.conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY m_preview.created_at DESC, m_preview.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_preview, ( SELECT MAX(m_read.read_at) FROM messages m_read WHERE m_read.conversation_id = c.id ) AS last_read_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM conversations c WHERE c.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET peer_user_id = #{peerUserId}, last_message_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_message_at, #{lastMessageAt}), #{lastMessageAt}) WHERE id = #{id}
